notes.title: Update V0.1.1 - Better Physics & More!
notes.content:
My new machine arrived a whole week early, so I wasted no time setting it up and building out version 0.1.1.

This update brings improvements to the settings menu, giving you more control over physics and time-of-day options:


Breast Physics Settings
You can now tweak three key parameters:

Dampening: controls how motion slows down

Elasticity: adjusts the bounce and rebound

Stiffness: fine-tunes overall firmness

On top of that, there’s a new Surface Physics toggle. Turn it on to add skin rippling effects when under pressure.


Time of Day Options
Choose how the world looks and feels:

Real-Time – syncs with your system clock

Morning / Afternoon / Evening / Night – pick a static time of day

Debug – cycles day/night super fast (originally built for testing lighting, but it’s surprisingly fun to watch!)

That’s it for this round, but I’ve got more in the pipeline. Keep an eye on the news section for the next big update!

notes.title: Trading cards & customizable boob physics are coming to BOOBS!
notes.content:
Trading cards are coming to BOOBS! 


Trading cards and community items are officially coming to BOOBS!
I’m super proud to announce that Steam has selected BOOBS to include community items, a huge milestone for me personally. I never expected when I first started making a boob-touching game, that it'd be this successful. THANK YOU SO MUCH!!!

Trading Cards & Microtransactions
I’ve already created a set of trading cards, and they’ve been approved! The only catch is that free games can’t publish cards unless they have in-game microtransactions. My original plan was to release the next DLC, “The Grabbing Hands”, as a standalone package with new hand skins.

Instead, I’ll be reworking this into an in-game store where you can pick and choose which new hand styles you want to unlock. Not only does this give you more freedom (you don't have to buy all in 1 package), but it also allows BOOBS to have trading cards. And the best part? You’ll be able to sell them on the Steam Market and earn yourself some sweet Steam Wallet cash.


New Hardware Incoming </3
On the less fun side, my old Legion 5 (2021) laptop gave up after the power connector broke (yes, I even tried soldering a new connector in which worked for a bit then broke again 😅). So I’ve ordered a brand-new development machine from Lenovo, which should arrive by September 1st. Thankfully, I had full backups on a separate SSD (and of course versioning), so no progress was lost. This means however, that my hands are tied for the next one and a half weeks.

Change BOOB physics in the next update!
While I wait for my new rig, I’ve got an update ready to go on my SSD that I’ll release once I’m back in action. The most important thing this update brings is boob physics customization. Basically, you’ll be able to adjust firmness. There are three sliders that allow you to change how to the boobs jiggle. On top of that, you can choose to turn on or off skin deformation. Finally, you can change the time in the game. In the settings you can choose either Real-Time (syncs to your system clock) or choose from morning, afternoon, evening, night, or debug mode (for a speedy day/night cycle).  



So in short, new content is on the way and trading cards are coming!

notes.title: Upcoming Update 1 – What’s Coming Soon! (still working hard on it)
notes.content:
BOOBS has been released and the reviews are dripping in. (If you haven't reviewed the game, please do! <3)

Some reviews mentioned a handful of issues. If you run into issues please don't write a negative review but post it in the discussion boards. 


I’m currently working on a new update to improve your experience with BOOBS. Here’s what you can expect:

Resolution Settings: You’ll be able to adjust the game’s resolution directly. 

Sound Settings: You'll be able to control the volume to your liking with new sound options.

Steam Deck Fixes: Controller support on Steam Deck is being addressed to make gameplay smoother. 

Performance Improvements: Optimizations to help the game run better on Steam Deck devices (and all other devices but on Steam Deck it's very noticeable).

Slap Tracking: The game will store and load your total number of slaps, plus show how many slaps you’ve done in your current session (which is relevant for the achievements).

Visual Fixes: Fixing an issue where hair was rendering behind clothes for a more polished look.

Thanks for your patience and support — can’t wait to get this update out to you! If you run into any more issues, please post it in the discussion boards. I'm monitoring them <3.
